The patch was submitted successfully. I will now provide the final summary.

The fix introduces a `ResponseContextManager` context manager in `fastapi/routing.py` to explicitly hold the `AsyncExitStack` until the endpoint execution and response handling are complete. This ensures that dependency cleanup logic (especially for generators using `yield`) is executed only after the response has been fully processed, resolving the issue where exit codes were not running correctly after `StreamingResponse` or `UploadFile` usage.
